name: Himuro Shizuka
source:
The most feared woman in Tenkaiku. 
She's the eldest daughter of the Himuro family and effectively manages the Hakurou-gumi. 

She's determined to shape her younger brother, Shou, into a great leader. Fearless and sharp-tongued, she never backs down from a challenge, even when faced with unreasonable situations. 

Her orders are absolute, and the men of Hakurou-gumi fear and respect her.

Part of Hakurou-gumi
